description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plot_Smoothed_Radar', which extends 'Image_Graph_Plot_Smoothed_Bezier' to implement a smoothed radar chart as part of a graph rendering library. It contains the implementation of a private method '_done' that produces the radar plot, utilizing control points and splines.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Smoothed_Radar
classes.description: A class for rendering smoothed radar charts using Bezier curves in the Image_Graph charting library.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Private method that handles rendering the smoothed radar plot by processing dataset points, calculating control points for splines, drawing splines, and managing graphical groups.
